'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of North Gaza]]
****More than 50 children are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in [[Jabalia]] in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] in the past two days. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/3/over-50-children-killed-in-israeli-strikes-in-gazas-jabalia-in-2-days-un (Al Jazeera)]
***At least 31 people are killed in [[Israel]]i airstrikes across the Gaza Strip, primarily in northern Gaza, according to [[Palestinian]] medics. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-attacks-kill-23-people-gaza-medics-say-ceasefire-hopes-dim-2024-11-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Pokrovsk offensive]]
****The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defense]] and [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] military news site [[DeepStateMap.Live|DeepStateUA]] report that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] has captured the settlement of [[Vyshneve, Pokrovsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Vyshneve]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine, with [[Armed Forces of Russia|Russian troops]] advancing towards Hryhorivka to the west. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-capture-new-village-donetsk-region-ukraine-acknowledges-fighting-2024-11-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes]]
***Dozens of people are killed in a series of [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on over two dozen settlements in the [[Beqaa Valley]] in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/11/3/live-israel-attacks-gaza-polio-centre-syria-lebanon-border-crossing (Al Jazeera)]
**Three people are killed and nine others are injured in [[Israel]]i airstrikes in [[Sidon]], Lebanon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/11/3/live-israel-attacks-gaza-polio-centre-syria-lebanon-border-crossing?update=3293917 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**At least eleven people are injured in a [[grenade]] explosion caused by an unknown militant group in a [[flea market]] in [[Srinagar]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/eleven-injured-militant-attack-indias-kashmir-2024-11-03/ (Reuters)]
**Three rebels are killed and four security personnel are injured during two separate [[shootout]]s in [[Anantnag district]], Jammu and Kashmir, India. [https://apnews.com/article/kashmir-india-pakistan-gunfight-insurgency-f52a3b971a1c70652045472361b0d3c0 (AP)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**Two police officers are injured in a [[stabbing attack]] by [[Naxalites|Naxalite insurgents]] in [[Sukma]], [[Chhattisgarh]], India, with their weapons being stolen. [https://indianexpress.com/article/india/knife-attack-maoists-in-chhattisgarh-market-leaves-2-cops-injured-weapons-looted-9650868/ (''Indian Express'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Three people are killed and several others are injured when [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] fires several mortar shells into the Halane base camp in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/87168/atmis-condemns-deadly-mortar-attack-on-mogadishus-halane-camp (''The Eastleigh Voice'')] [https://horseedmedia.net/deadly-mortar-attack-halane-base-somalia-394515 (Horseed Media)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A truck plunges into a ravine in [[Morona-Santiago Province]], [[Ecuador]], killing ten people. A 3-year-old girl is the sole survivor of the crash, according to police. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-amazon-truck-crash-47120b32fc6c646923cc1d348afa3030 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Air pollution in Lahore]]
**The [[air pollution]] in [[Lahore]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]], reaches a record-high [[air quality index]] score of 1,900, with the [[Government of Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab government]] ordering a mandatory closure of all primary schools for one week, blaming [[stubble burning]] for the poor air quality. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5ymg64ynm7o (BBC News)] [https://www.geo.tv/latest/572374-lahore-residents-forced-to-breath-highly-toxic-air-as-aqi-surpasses-1000-again (Geo News)] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/at-aqi-of-1-900-this-pakistan-city-is-worlds-most-polluted-blames-winds-from-india-6940977 (NDTV)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2024 Moldovan presidential election]]
**[[Moldovans]] vote for a [[President of Moldova|President]] in the second round of the presidential election. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/03/moldova-votes-president-unoff-election-as-russia-hovers (''The Guardian'')]
**Incumbent President [[Maia Sandu]] wins reelection, defeating former [[Office of the Prosecutor General of Moldova|Prosecutor General]] [[Alexandr Stoianoglo]] amid allegations of [[Russia]]n interference. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/04/pro-eu-incumbent-maia-sandu-re-elected-to-second-term-as-president-of-moldova (Euronews)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-holds-presidential-runoff-election-amid-claims-russian-meddling-2024-11-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]]
**Hundreds of activists engage in demonstrations in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]], to protest state [[corruption]] and [[negligence]] by [[Government of Serbia|Serbian officials]] which lead to the deadly collapse of a canopy at the [[Novi Sad railway station]] on Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/activists-rally-belgrade-protest-railway-station-disaster-2024-11-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Spain floods]]
**Protestors pelt the [[Felipe VI|King]] and [[Queen Letizia of Spain|Queen of Spain]], [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]], and [[President of the Valencian Government|Valencian President]] [[Carlos Mazón]] with objects and mud and boo them as "murderers" during their visit to [[Paiporta]], [[Valencian Community|Valencia]]. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is evacuated from the area after being hit with a shovel. [https://www.levante-emv.com/videos/comunitat-valenciana/2024/11/03/abucheos-autoridades-llegada-paiporta-111307119.html (''Levante'')] [https://apnews.com/article/spain-floods-king-protest-mud-a8525bd82cf4cc3fc6273d535cbb9d66 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cvg4p0y3xlpt (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Japan Series]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Yokohama DeNA BayStars]] defeat the [[Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks]] to win the [[Japan Series]] in six games, capturing their third championship and their first since [[1998 Japan Series|1998]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/news/html/20241103/k10014628181000.html (NHK)]
*[[2024 New York City Marathon]]
**Somali-[[Netherlands|Dutch]] distance runner [[Abdi Nageeye]] wins the 53rd New York City Marathon men's race with a time of 2:07:39. [[Kenya]]n distance runner [[Sheila Chepkirui]] wins the women's race with a time of 2:24:35. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/11/03/nyregion/nyc-marathon (''The New York Times'')]
